brief:
The Central Zakat Committee in Hebron launched a food parcel distribution project targeting 300 families, Ma'an news agency reported. The initiative received funding from the Jordanian Advocacy Committee and aims to provide essential supplies to vulnerable households in the area.

The project represents a coordinated humanitarian effort between Palestinian and Jordanian organizations to address food insecurity among families in Hebron.
title: Hebron Zakat Committee distributes food parcels to 300 families
